newsitem.title: USA: NationsBank near deal to buy Montgomery.
newsitem.headline: NationsBank near deal to buy Montgomery.

text.p: NationsBank Corp. is close to finalizing a deal to buy San Francisco-based investment bank Montgomery Securities Inc. for more than $1 billion, people familiar with the negotiations said Friday.
A merger between the two firms would the latest in a growing trend of combinations between commercial banks and brokerage houses.
Earlier this month, BankAmerica Corp said it would buy investment bank Robertson Stephens & Co, another San Francisco investment bank, for about $540 million.
In April, Bankers Trust New York Corp. agreed to buy Alex Brown & Sons Inc. for $1.7 billion, and a month later Swiss Bank Corp. agreed to buy Dillon Read & Co. for $600 million.
The wave of mergers is sparked by a recent easing of Federal Reserve restrictions on commercial banks' ability to engage in brokerage activities.
According to people familar with the negotiations, an announcement could be made as early as this weekend following a meeting of Montgomery's partners.
Representatives from both firms declined to comment on the report or whether an agreement had been reached.
Montgomery, based in San Francisco, specializes in high technology firms. The brokerage firm had 1996 revenues of $705 million.
NationsBank stock fell $1.375 to $65.25 on the New York Stock Exchange.
